title: CIRewind deterministic review fixture index v1alpha1
description: A closed, bounded index of synthetic review scenarios and their local archive snapshots. It records fixture inputs only and does not establish that a scenario was executed or that any incident fact is true.

scenarios.$comment: Canonical instances sort rows strictly by scenarioId and use each scenarioId once; semantic validation enforces key ordering and uniqueness.

snapshotPath.description: A fixed local fixture path; consumers must never interpret it as a network locator.
